homepage.welcomeSubtitle: Where Every Creation Tells A Celebration Story
homepage.welcomeStory: Founded in the heart of the culinary district, Liya's Bake brings timeless Parisian pastry techniques together with modern flavor palettes. We handcraft every batch using 100% organic French butter, Madagascar bourbon vanilla, and locally harvested berries.

storyParagraphs: At Liya's Bake, we believe that baking is a harmony of chemistry and soul. We never compromise on ingredients — using single-origin Valrhona chocolate, farm-fresh pasture eggs, and slow-fermented starters.

Every morning before dawn, our bakers hand-laminate flaky viennoiserie doughs and simmer silky curds. By opening time, our counter is overflowing with crisp viennoiserie, golden brioche, and bespoke celebration cakes.
Rooted in warm Bengaluru hospitality, our boutique bakery on Masjid Road Chickpet serves as a gathering place for lovers of genuine craftsmanship and unhurried patisserie art.
about.mission: To elevate life's everyday and monumental moments through extraordinary, handcrafted baked delights.
about.vision: To be recognized globally as a benchmark of artisanal bakery excellence and sustainable luxury patisserie.

bakers.name: Liya Vance
bakers.bio: Trained in classic Parisian patisserie with over 12 years creating showstopping architectural wedding tiers.

bakers.name: Marcelle Dubois
bakers.bio: Specialist in 72-hour cultured butter lamination, sourdough fermentation, and traditional French baguettes.

bakers.name: Elena Rostova
bakers.bio: Celebrated for hand-sculpted sugar florals, gold-leaf marbling, and bespoke custom celebratory centerpieces.

timeline.title: The Humble Hearth
timeline.description: Started as a bespoke micro-bakery oven crafting personalized birthday tiers for local neighbors.

timeline.title: Mastering French Techniques
timeline.description: Expanded recipe catalog to include slow-fermented sourdoughs and laminated French croissants.

timeline.title: Boutique Bakery Counter
timeline.description: Opened our flagship storefront at Jolly Mohalla, Masjid Road Chickpet in Bengaluru.

timeline.title: Artisanal Destination
timeline.description: Cherished by patrons across the city for unforgettable custom cake creations and morning viennoiserie.
